_comment: Active abilities granted by parts (a part's grid.ability names one of these). `free` abilities do not use the machine's action. `cooldown` is in rounds, counted from the round it was used. `short` is the effect in a few words, on the ability's card in the fight (016); `text` the whole of it, effect first -- whether it is free is said by the card, not by the text.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Run up to 3 hexes in a straight line and slam into the first thing there: 3 damage, +1 for every hex run (up to 5), and a shove. Works after moving.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.text: Hook a unit 2-3 hexes away in a clear line and drag it next to you. Dragged over a pit, it falls in. Anchored frames hold their ground.

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.text: Drop a crate wall (3 HP) on an empty hex next to you. It blocks moves and shots until it breaks.

focus.name: Focus
focus.text: Your next attack or Charge this turn deals +2.

dash.name: Dash
dash.text: Move again, up to 2 hexes -- even after attacking.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.text: Your next attack or Charge this turn deals +2, and costs 2 more heat.

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: This machine and every ally next to it take 2 less from each hit, until your next turn.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.text: Pull in a scrap pile up to 2 hexes away -- its scrap and 2 HP -- without moving.
